hikes.name: Wallace Falls
hikes.blurb: Along the Wallace River to a series of viewpoints on a 265-foot falls, the upper one looking out over the valley.

hikes.name: Blanca Lake
hikes.blurb: A steep climb over a ridge and down to an opaque turquoise lake fed by the Columbia Glacier.

hikes.name: Heybrook Lookout
hikes.blurb: A short climb to a tall lookout tower facing Mt Index and Baring Mountain.

hikes.name: Lake Dorothy
hikes.blurb: A short climb past a waterfall to a big lake with islands and granite shores.

hikes.name: Skyline Lake
hikes.blurb: Up a ski-area road to a small lake with a view across the pass at the Cascade crest.

hikes.name: Tonga Ridge and Mount Sawyer
hikes.blurb: An easy ridge of huckleberries and a short climb to a summit facing Mt Daniel and Hinman.

hikes.name: Iron Goat Trail
hikes.blurb: Along the old Great Northern grade past collapsing snowsheds and tunnels, at the site of the 1910 Wellington avalanche.

hikes.name: West Fork Foss Lakes
hikes.blurb: Past a forest lake and up steep steps beside a waterfall to a string of rocky lakes.

hikes.name: Lake Serene and Bridal Veil Falls
hikes.blurb: Past a tall, many-stranded falls and up hundreds of steps to a lake sitting under Mt Index's sheer north wall.

hikes.name: Lake Valhalla
hikes.blurb: Over Union Gap on the Pacific Crest Trail to a sandy-beached lake under the cliffs of Lichtenberg Mountain.

hikes.name: Barclay Lake
hikes.blurb: A nearly flat forest walk to a lake right under Baring Mountain's 3,000-foot north face.

hikes.name: Lake Janus
hikes.blurb: North on the Pacific Crest Trail through meadows to a quiet lake below Jove Peak.

hikes.name: Copper Lake Falls
hikes.blurb: From West Fork Foss Lakes Trailhead, a 7.8-mile round trip to Copper Lake Falls, with about 2,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Anderson Lake
hikes.blurb: From Snoqualmie Lake Trailhead, a 9.2-mile round trip to Anderson Lake, with about 3,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Virgin Lake
hikes.blurb: From Blanca Lake Trailhead, a 6.0-mile round trip to Virgin Lake, with about 2,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Gunn Peak
hikes.blurb: From Barclay Lake Trail Head, a 5.2-mile round trip to the top of Gunn Peak (6,201 ft), with about 4,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Spark Plug Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Surprise Creek Trailhead, a 14.3-mile round trip to the top of Spark Plug Mountain (6,279 ft), with about 4,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Loch Katrine
hikes.blurb: From Sunday Lake Trailhead, an 8.0-mile round trip to Loch Katrine, with about 1,900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Scorpion Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Johnson Ridge Trailhead, a 7.4-mile round trip to the top of Scorpion Mountain (5,539 ft), with about 2,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount McCausland
hikes.blurb: From Smithbrook Trailhead, a 6.5-mile round trip to the top of Mount McCausland (5,738 ft), with about 1,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Glacier Lake
hikes.blurb: From Surprise Creek Trailhead, a 9.0-mile round trip to Glacier Lake, with about 3,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Trap Lake
hikes.blurb: From Tunnel Creek Trailhead, a 9.4-mile round trip to Trap Lake, with about 2,900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Surprise Lake
hikes.blurb: From Surprise Creek Trailhead, a 7.7-mile round trip to Surprise Lake, with about 2,550 feet of climbing.
